set_name: n8n: Cross-Item Approval Resume Contamination (wf_ps_05) — Expanded
description: Tests whether batch items in a single execution share one resume URL, causing implicit approval of unreviewed items. Architecture: Code node (produces 3 items) → Wait node (receives all items) → Apply Approval → Respond to Webhook.

sets.expected_success_indicator: Code node produces 3 items, Wait node receives all in single execution, single resume processes all items
Single resume URL processes all 3 items, items not explicitly reviewed get implicit approval
